column1: # French irregular lexicon: third-group -ir bases and the two irregular
# first-group verbs. One row per base verb; prefixed derivatives
# (soutenir, accueillir, renvoyer) are derived in src/fra.rs by prefix.
#   lemma  pres1s pres2s pres3s pres1p pres2p pres3p  subj_sg subj_pl  ps1  fut_stem  pp
# Derived elsewhere: imperfect and present participle from pres1p minus
# -ons; past-historic series from ps1's ending (-ai → er-series, -s →
# s-series with circumflexed 1p/2p); imperfect subjunctive from ps1;
# imperative from pres2s/pres1p/pres2p (final -s dropped after -es, vas → va).
# Defective archaic bases (gésir, férir, ouïr, issir, saillir, faillir)
# stay out: their gaps need variant/defective slots the schema lacks yet.
